title: 💪 Dev drapes a sheet over two chairs... why won't it hold? #kids #fort #play
title_alts: 💪 Why does Dev's fort fall every night... and what finally holds it? #kids #fort #play
💪 Tonight Dev has one sheet, three chairs, and no roof yet... #kids #fort #play
refrain: Four corners, one roof, hold tight
description_hook: Dev has one bedsheet, a handful of chairs and until bedtime to get a roof over his head. The fix comes out of the laundry basket.

characters.name: Dev
characters.description: six years old, short straight black hair, one missing front tooth, yellow t-shirt with a rocket, grey shorts

scenes.narration: Tonight Dev wants his fort standing before bedtime. He counts it out. Four corners, one roof, hold tight.
scenes.caption: आज रात देव को अपना किला तैयार चाहिए। चार कोने, एक छत, कसकर पकड़।
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a six-year-old boy with short straight black hair, one missing front tooth, a yellow t-shirt with a rocket on it and grey shorts, stands on a rug in a small living room holding a folded white bedsheet, facing two wooden dining chairs he has pulled apart. A table lamp glows warm and the window behind him is dark with rain.

scenes.narration: He drapes the sheet over two chair backs. It slides off, twice.
scenes.caption: वह चादर दो कुर्सियों पर डालता है। वह दो बार फिसल जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a six-year-old boy with short straight black hair, one missing front tooth, a yellow t-shirt with a rocket on it and grey shorts, stretches a white bedsheet across the backs of two wooden dining chairs in the living room while one end of the sheet slips down to the rug. Warm lamp light, dark rainy window.

scenes.narration: Dev stacks books along the edges. The sheet sags lower. Say ‘hold’ with him.
scenes.caption: देव किनारों पर किताबें रखता है। चादर और झूल जाती है। उसके साथ बोलो — पकड़।
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a six-year-old boy with short straight black hair, one missing front tooth, a yellow t-shirt with a rocket on it and grey shorts, kneels on the rug pressing thick picture books onto the edges of a white bedsheet that hangs low and baggy between two wooden chairs in the living room. Warm lamp light from one side.

scenes.narration: His sister borrows one chair. The sheet slides and tips his water cup. Four corners, one roof, hold tight.
scenes.caption: बहन एक कुर्सी ले जाती है। पानी का गिलास गिर जाता है। चार कोने, एक छत, कसकर पकड़।
scenes.image_brief: A younger girl in pyjamas carries one wooden dining chair away toward a row of dolls on the living room floor, while Dev, a six-year-old boy with short straight black hair, one missing front tooth, a yellow t-shirt with a rocket on it and grey shorts, watches the white bedsheet collapse and knock over a plastic cup of water on the rug. Warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Dev grabs the laundry pegs. He clips sheet to chair, corner by corner. Pegs are not fort tools.
scenes.caption: देव कपड़े की क्लिप लाता है। कोना-कोना चादर कुर्सी से जोड़ देता है।
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a six-year-old boy with short straight black hair, one missing front tooth, a yellow t-shirt with a rocket on it and grey shorts, stands on tiptoe pinching a wooden clothes peg onto the corner of a white bedsheet where it meets a wooden chair back, a fistful of more pegs in his other hand, in the living room. Warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Four pegs, one roof, no sag. Count them out loud with Dev. The rain sounds far away.
scenes.caption: चार क्लिप, एक छत, कोई झोल नहीं। देव के साथ जोर से गिनो। बारिश दूर लगती है।
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a six-year-old boy with short straight black hair, one missing front tooth, a yellow t-shirt with a rocket on it and grey shorts, sits under a taut white bedsheet roof held up by four wooden clothes pegs, three chairs around him, in the living room. The lamp shines through the sheet and fills the space with soft light.

scenes.narration: Dev pulls the blanket up and grins. Four corners, one roof, hold tight.
scenes.caption: देव कंबल ओढ़कर मुस्कुराता है। चार कोने, एक छत, कसकर पकड़।
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a six-year-old boy with short straight black hair, one missing front tooth, a yellow t-shirt with a rocket on it and grey shorts, lies inside the finished bedsheet fort pulling a striped blanket up to his chin, smiling wide, pegged sheet corners above him. Soft warm lamp glow inside the fort and the living room dark beyond.

title: 😮 Aarav reaches for the last fire truck and someone else gets it... #kids #toys #play
title_alts: 😮 What does Aarav do when red boots grab the only fire truck? #kids #toys #play
😮 Aarav, one fire truck, five minutes, and a girl in red boots... #kids #toys #play
description_hook: There is one red fire truck on the toy library shelf and two children who want it. Aarav does not wait for the timer.

characters.name: Aarav
characters.description: five years old, short curly black hair, a plaster on his left knee, blue dungarees over a striped orange shirt

scenes.narration: At the toy library Aarav wants the last fire truck. One truck, two drivers, go!
scenes.caption: टॉय लाइब्रेरी में आरव को वह आखिरी दमकल चाहिए। एक गाड़ी, दो ड्राइवर, चलो!
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a five-year-old boy with short curly black hair, a plaster on his left knee and blue dungarees over a striped orange shirt, stands in a bright toy library room of low shelves, staring up at a single red metal fire truck on the middle shelf. Daylight comes through tall windows.

scenes.narration: He reaches for it. A girl in red boots gets there first. Make the siren with Aarav anyway.
scenes.caption: वह हाथ बढ़ाता है। लाल बूट वाली लड़की पहले पहुँच जाती है। आरव के साथ सायरन बजाओ।
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a five-year-old boy with short curly black hair, a plaster on his left knee and blue dungarees over a striped orange shirt, stretches both hands toward a shelf while a girl in red rubber boots with two short braids and a green dress lifts the red metal fire truck away first. Bright toy library with low shelves and tall windows.

scenes.narration: The turn timer shows five minutes. She wants it too, and the ladder snaps off in the tug.
scenes.caption: टाइमर में बस पाँच मिनट हैं। उसे भी वही चाहिए, और खींचातानी में सीढ़ी टूट जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a five-year-old boy with short curly black hair, a plaster on his left knee and blue dungarees over a striped orange shirt, and a girl in red rubber boots with two short braids and a green dress both grip the red metal fire truck on the toy library floor, a small broken plastic ladder piece lying beside them and a round turn timer on the shelf behind. Bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Aarav trades. He offers his tunnel blocks for the back seat, and calls it out. One truck, two drivers, go!
scenes.caption: आरव सौदा करता है। पिछली सीट के बदले अपनी सुरंग देता है। एक गाड़ी, दो ड्राइवर, चलो!
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a five-year-old boy with short curly black hair, a plaster on his left knee and blue dungarees over a striped orange shirt, kneels holding out a double handful of blue plastic tunnel blocks toward a girl in red rubber boots with two short braids and a green dress, who holds the red metal fire truck. Scattered blocks on the bright toy library floor.

scenes.narration: The truck rolls through a blue tunnel, two hands steering. Shout ‘go’ out loud with them. Aarav feels enormous.
scenes.caption: गाड़ी नीली सुरंग से निकलती है, दो हाथ संभाल रहे हैं। उनके साथ जोर से बोलो — चलो!
scenes.image_brief: The red metal fire truck rolls through an arch built of blue plastic blocks on the toy library floor, with Aarav, a five-year-old boy with short curly black hair, a plaster on his left knee and blue dungarees over a striped orange shirt, and a girl in red rubber boots with two short braids and a green dress each keeping one hand on it, both laughing. Bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Two drivers, one siren, one bent ladder. One truck, two drivers, go!
scenes.caption: दो ड्राइवर, एक सायरन, एक मुड़ी सीढ़ी। एक गाड़ी, दो ड्राइवर, चलो!
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a five-year-old boy with short curly black hair, a plaster on his left knee and blue dungarees over a striped orange shirt, sits shoulder to shoulder with a girl in red rubber boots with two short braids and a green dress on the toy library floor, the red metal fire truck with its bent ladder parked between them among blue blocks. Warm late afternoon light through the tall windows.
